articles.title: The C-PACE Opportunity for Ground-Leased Properties
articles.narrative: This article explores how Commercial Property Assessed Clean Energy (C-PACE) financing can effectively address the unique challenges of ground-leased properties, which are often perceived as obstacles to traditional mortgage financing due to complex lease provisions and collateral risks. The author argues that C-PACE offers a viable solution by providing long-term, fixed-rate capital that runs with the land, thereby mitigating risks for lenders and improving the overall capital stack efficiency. The piece highlights C-PACE's flexibility in ground lease structures, including those involving public or university land and tax credit projects, by citing examples of a multifamily development in Washington D.C. and a commercial kitchen facility in Chicago.

articles.title: The Plan: NYC’s First Flight Club Aims for a Bull’s-Eye at 31 Union Square West
articles.narrative: State of Play Hospitality is preparing to open the first New York City location for Flight Club, a U.K.-based darts-themed entertainment venue, at 31 Union Square West. The company sought a historically significant building with unique architectural features to align with the brand's aesthetic. The new venue, which previously housed the Bank of Metropolis and Blue Water Grill, will feature an upscale Victorian English pub design, retaining original elements like marble walls and mosaic tiles while incorporating high ceilings and signature lighting for its corporate and social clientele.

data_points.address: 31 Union Square West, New York City, NY
data_points.notable_features: Historically significant building, previously headquarters to the Bank of Metropolis, features original marble walls and mosaic tiles, high ceilings.
data_points.project_notes: The building was home to Blue Water Grill restaurant from 1996 to 2019. A mezzanine level was removed during renovation to increase ceiling heights.

articles.title: CIP Real Estate Buys San Gabriel Valley Industrial Park for $61M
articles.narrative: CIP Real Estate has acquired the Walnut Tech Business Center, an 11-building industrial and flex complex in Walnut, CA, for $60.7 million from an affiliate of AEW. The property, which is 92% leased, comprises 109 suites and is strategically located near the 60 Freeway, serving the supply-constrained City of Industry area. CIP plans a $3.5 million capital improvement program for the asset, recognizing the scarcity of quality small bay industrial parks in this Southern California submarket.

data_points.project_notes: CIP plans a $3.5 million capital improvement program for the property.

articles.title: The Goldie Initiative celebrates 2026-2027 Goldie Scholars
articles.narrative: The Goldie Initiative, an organization dedicated to advancing women in commercial real estate, celebrated its 2026-2027 Goldie Scholars at its annual Goldie Gala in Chicago. The event, attended by over 1,100 people, contributed to the more than $1.6 million raised this year to support scholarships, mentorship, and professional development for women pursuing graduate-level real estate programs. articles.title: Before you deploy AI, ask if your data is ready
articles.narrative: This article argues that the success of AI deployment in facilities management hinges on the quality and structure of an organization's operational data, rather than the speed of tool implementation. The author contends that facilities leaders often make mistakes by selecting tools before assessing data readiness, deploying narrow AI solutions instead of integrated systems, and neglecting data governance. For AI initiatives to yield tangible results, data must be clean, connected, and consistently structured across various systems, enabling AI to draw reliable conclusions and provide actionable insights for maintenance, space utilization, and lease management. The core message is that a unified operational platform with well-governed data is the essential foundation for any AI tool to deliver real value.

articles.title: Inland Mortgage Capital closes $44 million in bridge loans for projects in Wisconsin, Illinois and California

articles.title: Gantry Arranges Life Company Loan on Temecula Offices
